message.content:
The **United States Declaration of Independence** was signed by 56 delegates of the Second Continental Congress on **July 4, 1776**. The signers represented the thirteen American colonies and were:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Dickinson, Benjamin Franklin, James Smith, George Clymer, Robert Morris, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross, John Morton, William Allen, John Penn, John Penn (the younger), John Penn (the elder) |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston (again), John Witherspoon (again) |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, John Jay, William Floyd (again), Philip Livingston (again), Lewis Morris (again), John Jay (again) |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott, William Williams (again), Oliver Wolcott (again) |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, John Hancock (again), Joseph Warren (again) |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, John Henry, Charles Carroll (again), Samuel Chase (again), John Henry (again) |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Patrick Henry, Thomas Jefferson (again), James Madison (again), Patrick Henry (again) |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn, William Hooper (again), Joseph Hewes (again), John Penn (again) |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., John Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr. (again), John Rutledge (again) |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton, Button Gwinnett (again), Lyman Hall (again), George Walton (again) |

These individuals were chosen by their respective colonies to represent them at the Continental Congress and to sign the Declaration, formally declaring the colonies' independence from Great Britain.
